decisions.rationale: All 4 axes green; SDK overage confirmed (~$200/month, at Max 20x credit ceiling); pivot deadline 2026-06-07. Sprint A Story 1 (production PTY daemon) is the single go/no-go gate.

axes.emulator: green — charmbracelet/x/vt covers OSC 52, alt screen, bracketed paste, mouse, scrollback; active maintainer
axes.pty_daemon: green — creack/pty PTY ownership, 1MiB ring buffer, multi-client attach, signal handling all verified in PoC
axes.autopilot_path: green (no impact) — autopilot/sprint use Agent tool (interactive billing), zero Agent SDK / claude -p calls
axes.sdk_credit: overage — 2-week actual $98.96 extrapolates to $198-$210/month; sprint-heavy months exceed by $50-$150

decisions.rationale: OSC 52 callback support is critical for palmux2 clipboard integration. charmbracelet/x/vt has RegisterOscHandler(52,...), active maintainer, scrollback API. vt10x silently ignores OSC 52 and is unmaintained since 2022.

decisions.verdict: claude-tui as new tab alongside claude-agent (opt-in)
decisions.rationale: claude-agent stays as opt-in high-feature path (stream-json mode); claude-tui becomes default for subscription billing via Go-owned PTY. This avoids a hard cutover and allows rollback.

internal/poc/pty/daemon.go Shutdown() lacks sync.Once guard and races with spawn-goroutine's cmd.Wait() on the same os.Process. PoC quality acceptable; production daemon must use sync.Once + channel signalling so only Shutdown() calls proc.Wait().

internal/poc/pty/server.go has a race between ring.Bytes() and Subscribe(). Sprint A must implement SnapshotAndSubscribe() that holds subMu during both the ring snapshot and subscriber registration so no live bytes are lost for the new client.

Sprint-level /review flagged that cmd/poc-pty/main.go was binding to all interfaces (`:port`) with no auth. Default changed to 127.0.0.1; added --bind flag for explicit LAN exposure. Safer default for a dev-only PoC tool.
